_note: Summary of the gate-region floors backing the mu >= 0.3803953504 headline.
REVISED 2026-07-26: the previous version of this file was hand-assembled and
two of its entries had no run record behind them.  R16/R17 were quoted from a
region 6 ONLY.  Every number below now points at a file that a driver wrote.
R17 moved 0.3803972 -> 0.3804045 when actually run against the N=48000 anchors.
anchors_caveat: That file's 'config' field reads {'N': 20000, ...} and is WRONG -- stale
metadata copied from the emitter's default.  The anchors themselves are the
N=48000 ones: cde_n30_iter3 p_lo = 0.3804139487691392, matching the N=48000
row of the state note.  Verified 2026-07-26; only the label is stale.

note: Stable across n_grid 801/1601 and depth 20/24.  At n_grid=401 it under-
resolves to 0.3803953255 (-2.5e-8), which is why the grid must be stated.
The single-grid convention _fs_recompute used to report is 5.45e-6 lower;
both are rigorous, adaptive is strictly stronger (per-sub-box L_max).

region_provenance.R6: gate_regions_reeval_N48000.json (ran at N=48000 anchors, target 0.3803954, depth 22, base 41)
region_provenance.R7: fullspace_promote_R7.json -- NOT re-run at the N=48000 anchors; still a valid LB (the new anchors are strictly higher) and already 1.6e-4 above the core, so re-running can only raise it
region_provenance.R9: gate_region_R9_N48000.json (dedicated divide-and-conquer; _regions_reeval's generic driver is weaker here and returns 0.3801638)

R9_detail.note: single grid fails only on eps (grid_min 0.3804300, Lmax 0.393); adaptive base=41 depth=18 clears in 27 leaves

margins_over_core._note: R16 and R9 sit within 3e-6 of the core.  Any further core gain runs straight into them, so a raised core floor requires re-running these two at the higher target in the same commit.

target_limited_caveat: Every adaptive floor here stops as soon as a sub-box clears its target, so
each is 'at least this', never an infimum.  Raising the target makes them
subdivide further and report higher, still-rigorous floors.  Do not read any
of these as a ceiling on what the region can give.
